This 2023 Dodge Charger R/T delivers commanding performance wrapped in distinctive White exterior styling, ready to turn heads on every drive.

- HEMI 5.7L V8 engine with multi-displacement technology for powerful performance
- 8-speed automatic transmission with rear-wheel drive
- Blacktop Package featuring 20" black noise painted wheels and aggressive styling cues
- Plus Group with blind spot detection, cross path detection, and projector LED fog lamps
- Power sunroof for open-air driving enjoyment
- Uconnect 4C with 8.4" touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 1-year Guardian trial and 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot
- Heated and ventilated front performance seats with power adjustments and lumbar support
- Heated steering wheel for enhanced comfort in cold weather
- Advanced safety suite including electronic stability control, traction control, and multiple airbag systems
- ParkView rear backup camera for convenient parking and maneuvering
- Auto-dimming exterior driver mirror and power door mirrors with heating
- Black 1-piece performance spoiler and satin black badging for aggressive styling
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist technology
- Sport steering wheel with audio and cruise controls

This R/T combines the classic American muscle car heritage with modern conveniences and safety technologies. The HEMI engine delivers the performance enthusiasts expect, achieving 16 MPG city and 25 MPG highway. Inside, the performance-tuned cabin features premium stitching on the dash panel, leather shift knob, and a sport steering wheel that puts you in command. The comprehensive safety system provides confidence whether navigating city streets or cruising the highway.

The Blacktop Package transforms the Charger's appearance with coordinated gloss black and satin black accents throughout, including the distinctive grille badge and decklid badge. Combined with the 20" black noise painted wheels, this package creates a cohesive, aggressive aesthetic that demands attention. The power sunroof adds an element of luxury and connection to the open road.

Technology integration is seamless with Uconnect 4C connectivity. Your smartphone integrates directly through Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, giving you access to navigation, messaging, and entertainment without distraction. The SiriusXM Guardian emergency communication system provides added peace of mind, while the 4G LTE hotspot keeps you connected wherever the road takes you.

Comfort features make longer drives enjoyable. The heated and ventilated front performance seats adapt to seasonal conditions, while the heated steering wheel ensures warmth during winter months. Power lumbar adjustment for both driver and passenger allows personalized seating positions for maximum support and comfort.

This 2023 Dodge Charger R/T represents an opportunity to own a vehicle that balances raw power with modern technology and genuine luxury features. We invite you to experience this machine firsthand in our showroom and discover why it remains a compelling choice for drivers who refuse to compromise on performance or style.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will.
